title: Hymn and Choir
author: Juniper Villalobos
blurb: Mara Joubert, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
